decisions.reason: Removing Heyzine platform branding affects hosting presentation, not the PDF deliverable or its two-page-spread behavior.
The white-label request does not change the current launch deadline or required live-launch state.
The same message separately changes whitespace remediation, which is already represented; the Heyzine branding decision does not further change this Requirement.
Heyzine's platform branding is distinct from the magazine layout's WBEdition visual style and does not alter its existing attributes.
The platform white-label request does not affect image-resolution enhancement or asset preparation.
Heyzine branding is unrelated to the rendering clarity of supplied advertisement assets.
The hosting-platform branding decision does not change author names, photographs, sizing, coverage, or sourcing.
The white-label request does not change the selected body typeface, weight treatment, or readability requirement.
Removing Heyzine branding does not change table-of-contents completion or page-number accuracy.
